transcript:
Refining a Jacket Adding Shoulder Pads and Sleeve Heads  
In the library window, double-click to open the PracticeFiles folder, find A in DefineTuning, and then open Refining a Jacket Adding Shoulder Pads and Sleeve Heads.  
In the file Refining a Jacket, double-click or drag it into the 2D or 3D window.  
In the library window, double-click to open the Hardware and Trims folder, then locate the Shoulder Pads folder.  
Right-click the thumbnail of the required shoulder pad, a menu will pop up, select Add.  
A men’s shoulder pad needs to be loaded in this exercise file.  
Use the positioning ball tool in the 3D window.  
Arrange the shoulder pad inside the jacket.  
Select the shoulder pad piece.  
Right-click on the piece in the 3D window, from the pop-up menu select Freeze.  
Fix the shoulder pad in position 3.  
Activate simulation.  
After the simulation is complete, close the simulation.  
Unfreeze the shoulder pad.  
Activate the simulation again to smooth the shoulder pad.

Activate the simulation again to smooth the shoulder pad.

chunks.content: ## Refining a Jacket: Adding Shoulder Pads and Sleeve Heads This section explains the step-by-step procedure for adding and positioning shoulder pads in CLO, focusing on file management, selecting hardware, and using simulation to refine the fit. Key terms include PracticeFiles folder, Hardware and Trims library, positioning ball tool, freezing/unfreezing pieces, and simulation activation. ### Opening the Project and Accessing Files - In the **Library** window, navigate to the **PracticeFiles** folder. - Open the subfolder **A in DefineTuning**. - Locate and open the file **Refining a Jacket Adding Shoulder Pads and Sleeve Heads**. - Load the file by double-clicking or dragging it into the **2D or 3D window** for editing. ### Selecting and Adding Shoulder Pads - In the **Library** window, open the **Hardware and Trims** folder. - Locate the **Shoulder Pads** subfolder. - Right-click the thumbnail of the desired shoulder pad and select **Add** from the popup menu. - For this exercise, a **men’s shoulder pad** is required. ### Positioning and Fixing the Shoulder Pad - Use the **positioning ball tool** in the **3D window** to arrange the shoulder pad inside the jacket. - Select the shoulder pad piece in the 3D view. - Right-click on the shoulder pad and choose **Freeze** from the menu, locking it in place at position 3. ### Simulation for Refinement - Activate the **simulation** to adjust the garment’s fit with the shoulder pad in place. - After the simulation completes, close it. - Unfreeze the shoulder pad to allow adjustments. - Repeatedly activate the simulation multiple times to smooth and properly settle the shoulder pad within the jacket. This iterative simulation process ensures the shoulder pad integrates naturally with the jacket’s shape and fabric behavior.
